cold_prerequisite_and_arming: Before any subject activation use ordinary caller Activity and unique unrelated source; register target-name-specific foreign ActivityListener UNARMED. ShouldListenTo increments targetSeen count for matching target and always returns false; it does not sample unrelated/runtime sources. Assert targetSeen==0 immediately after registration, then assert unrelated baseline StartActivity returns null. Any existing target source is explicit invalid fixture.

Arm chosen one-shot fault only after those finite assertions; count every target callback whether throw enabled or not. Invoke source-owning public path through separate NoInlining helper after arming, with optional registration before any await so methodName is nonnull. If eager runtime initialization makes cold invalid, keep error as fixture and adjust invocation boundary; do not reset or patch static state.

After first hostile attempt DISARM THROW but KEEP RECORDER REGISTERED for second invocation. This proves source ctor total1 across cached optional null or required cached original fault. Removing observer would conceal retry attempts. After assertions remove fixture recorder and sources normally.

ActivitySource constructor registers itself before external ShouldListenTo; throwing constructor yields no returned disposable handle. One attempt/process-exit bounds hidden partial source lifetime; never claim product disposed a never-returned object or zero global hidden instances.

fixture_pitfalls: Do not implement child Fact as async after an earlier await before AddTelemetry registration: GetTestMethodInfo scans attributed synchronous stack and otherwise returns null, hiding optional source creation. Task-returning non-async NoInlining Fact with synchronous child prefix avoids this; healthy actual root OperationName assertion corroborates.

Optional healthy root parent caller is not present in TestActivityListener captured chart; BuildChart top rows require empty ParentId. Do not falsely assert healthy root row in writer under preexisting caller. Inspect actual root via public current Activity source/name, and create a separate root work span with Current temporarily null to test real writer row, restoring owned root afterward.

Disposal must use asynchronous ServiceProvider disposal for IAsyncDisposable-only listener; avoid synchronous provider.Dispose setup failure. Do not start actual in-memory bus unless intentional separate behavior is required.

Own listener samples all sources; unrelated probe null before activation and after disposal is a finite ownership oracle. Host MTP may have its own listeners: baseline probe assert detects incompatible environment; no false universal no-listener claim.

Source-null optional timeline has no direct metrics owner. Core B1 already proved typed independent meters. If extra optional-independent-metric control desired, use actual DI host IMeterFactory and scoped real listener, not a global fallback; do not claim optional test timeline owned or disabled host meters.

Keep child metadata and complete output in artifact archive even when product assertions fail; new native events require exact same test bytes for original/fixed/mutants. Filter miss/discovery/prewarmed/type-init before act/watchdog failures are excluded.
